# WJ102 · Hồ sơ chính sách

Group **WJ · Quản trị agent (Next.js)** · page · Next.js: **exists (design W2)** (`/admin/policy`) · account `owner`

## Purpose
Policy profiles: the screen where patient safety is a setting. It compares the two profiles rule by rule, assigns a profile to each Zalo account and agent, and confirms or rejects Zalo identity links.

## Agent and care context
- `patient_channel` (default): outgoing patient messages go to the review queue, only template messages are scheduled, patient content is not auto-memorised, red flags go to a doctor before any model call, PII is masked, marketing opt-out and birthdays are respected, and identity is verified before names, appointments or medicines are mentioned. `staff_assistant` is the original zalo-agent behaviour for staff-only accounts.
- When an agent runs inside an account, the stricter profile of the two applies.
- The assistant may mention a patient only after staff confirmed that the Zalo account is that patient (identity link).

## Who may see it
- Account in this frame: `owner` (a mock account of `mock/auth.ts`; the back end decides the real matrix, the menu is a convenience).
- Gate: `admin.policy` (the account list needs `admin.accounts`, the agent list `admin.agents`).
- Roles that can open the page: owner, manager.
- Menu entry: "Hồ sơ chính sách" in the section "Quản trị agent", shown when the role holds any of `admin.policy`.

## Key actions
- Select the profile of each account or agent ("Trợ lý nội bộ" / "Kênh bệnh nhân")
- "Xác nhận" / "Từ chối" a pending Zalo identity link
- Dialog "Chuyển sang Trợ lý nội bộ" when a stricter profile is relaxed

## Business rules
- (notice on the page) "Trợ lý chỉ được nhắc tên, lịch hẹn hay thuốc của một bệnh nhân sau khi tài khoản Zalo đó được nhân viên xác nhận là đúng người. Đối chiếu bằng hồ sơ hoặc gọi xác minh trước khi xác nhận."
- Patient safety is a policy profile, never a removed feature: `patient_channel` (the default: messages to patients go to the review queue and a person sends them; memory from patient content is off; image, video, document and web tools are off; a red flag goes to a doctor before any model call; personal data is masked before the model; identity of a Zalo user is confirmed before the assistant names a patient) and `staff_assistant` (internal, staff-only accounts). The profile is set per Zalo account and per agent, the stricter of the two applies (PLAN-AI01 section 5).
